You are implementing the AGY/Antigravity provider adapter for Ateam Next.

OBJECTIVE
Create a production-oriented AGY adapter implementation with parser fixtures and tests, limited strictly to the AGY provider directory.

RELEVANT FILES
src/domain/events.ts
src/domain/types.ts
src/process/runner.ts
src/providers/codex/adapter.ts
src/providers/codex/parser.ts
src/providers/codex/parser.test.ts
package.json

OWNERSHIP BOUNDARIES
You may create/edit only files under src/providers/agy/. Do not edit index.ts, cli.tsx, docs, package files, runtime, scheduler, process runner, or other provider directories. Do not commit. Do not push.

IMPLEMENTATION REQUIREMENTS
Implement AgyAdapter with id 'agy'. Use explicit executable plus argv only. Prefer structured noninteractive JSON path: agy -p <prompt> --output-format json. Probe with agy models or --version; do not fabricate auth/quota. Implement runOnce(message): Promise<AteamEvent[]> even if this is not yet in the shared interface. Normalize completion text into AgentStreamDelta plus READY. Normalize auth failures to AUTH_ERROR, rate limit-looking output to RateLimited, malformed JSON to RuntimeError. Parser should tolerate unknown fields.

TESTING EXPECTED
